::: {#exm-preorder}
#### Preorder, step by step

For the subtree $\operatorname{node}\paren{h, \mathtt{nil}, \operatorname{single}(j)}$ of $B$ (@exm-binary-tree),
the definition of preorder (@def-preorder) gives first

$$
\ba
\operatorname{preorder}\paren{\operatorname{single}(j)}
&= \operatorname{cons}\paren{j, \operatorname{app}(\mathtt{empty}, \mathtt{empty})}
\\&= \operatorname{cons}(j, \mathtt{empty}),
\ea
$$

and then

$$
\ba
& \operatorname{preorder}\paren{\operatorname{node}\paren{h, \mathtt{nil}, \operatorname{single}(j)}}
\\&= \operatorname{cons}\paren{h, \operatorname{app}\paren{\mathtt{empty}, \operatorname{cons}(j, \mathtt{empty})}}
\\&= \operatorname{cons}\paren{h, \operatorname{cons}(j, \mathtt{empty})},
\ea
$$

the list $h, j$.
In the same way, $\operatorname{preorder}(B)$ is the list $m, f, c, h, j, t, r, p, w$ of @sol-root-first.

:::
